decision.summary: Runtime transport and broker behavior is covered by Cell-native authority courts: the signed machine descriptor is only a pointer to real application/session/workshop/work-registry Cell roots; capabilities are runtime possession handles with graph-visible grants/events but no serialized live handle; the cloud gateway admits only graph-declared routes and preserves Agent Session/device custody boundaries.

authority_files.evidence: Added and ran the descriptor authority court; targeted transport courts also prove authenticated runtime requests, replay denial, graph-backed Workshop admission, runtime compliance denial, device proof, device handoff, stale claim recovery, and exact Agent Session ownership.

Capability courts prove unforgeable runtime possession, no graph serialization of live handles, immediate revocation, expiry, use budget, scope denial, bounded audit, and graph-visible grant/event facts.

Cloud gateway courts prove route allowlist, malformed-envelope fail-closed behavior, DPoP Agent Session binding, no client-side device-key provisioning, founder custody unbound-client rule, unlisted route denial, and no implicit TLS server start.
Signed local machine transport implementation exercised by the canonical courts.
Runtime capability broker implementation exercised by the canonical courts.
Cloud gateway implementation exercised by the canonical courts.

commands.command: python -m pytest tests_replica\test_application_machine_transport.py -q --timeout=180 -k "machine_descriptor_points_to_cell_authority or machine_transport_is_authenticated_replay_safe_and_cell_backed or machine_work_claim_fails_closed_on_red_runtime_compliance or baboom_device_proof_selects_its_catalog_body_and_fails_closed or cloud_gateway_device_binding_requires_the_same_device_as_baboom_session or founder_machine_session_binds_enrolled_device_to_baboom or device_handoff_work_is_one_graph_policy_bound_to_target_custody or machine_workshop_admission_rejects_protected_content_without_commit or stale_work_claim_recovery_requires_dead_capability"
